posts.title: Dreams

Post your dreams here. Here are mine:

-I was a boulder throwing contest, so I threw a boulder off a cliff. The Incredible Hulk then came up to me and criticized me. "Ha ha, you call that a throw? I'll show you how it's done." He then threw it off the cliff.

-I won a bet for 50 dollars, so I went to go buy RE5. I bought it and drove home. Then I realized that I somehow bought COD4.

-I got off a bus in front of an abandoned school. My friend said to me "dude, are you getting Fallout 3?" I then nodded and he said "cool! Spiders!" Then we did this secret handshake where a hands turned into spiders and we pushed them into each other.

posts.author: CyberMuffin
posts.title: Re: Dreams
posts.html:
My one time favourite and funnies dream ever:

This is just one of my crazy dreams and genre of my dreams change almost every night. Sometimes i remember them, sometimes i dont.

I think it was timed somewhere in the near future. A major war was going on and i were just an ordinary soldier. At first i had a team with me and we were infiltrating enemy territory. At some point all my team members except me disappeared and i was left alone in enemy territory. My dream quickly changed into kickass action movie and i were performing all kinds of crazy stunts and shooting enemies like there was no tomorrow. This kept going for some time and finally the whole war ended. I came back to my homecountry from the war and was considered a hero or some shit and got all kinds of freakin' medals from my actions in the war.

Later on as veteran, some secret agents rushed into my house and said they have a very sercet and importand mission for me and i must go. I was sent to russia and my mission was to assassinate some government members. I were walking on the streets to the place where my mission was supposed to start and i was caught by LOTS of snipers and all kind of guys trying to shoot the shit out of me. Funny thing was that everyone else used guns except me. No, i just pointed at them with my finger and they died. This also turned into a epic action movie as i blazed thru the streets with my finger of death and blew the shit out of the whole bunch of supposed evil dudes.

Soon after that i woke up and realizing what i just dreamed about, i started to laugh my ass off.
It doesnt sound as funny as it was when i write it, but if it could be made into a movie, you would laugh so hard you'd have a heart attack.

I have so many crazy dreams i could tell about, but thats just one of them.

Oh, and to balance this post a little from all the violence. I once dreamed about a medow and a hollow treetrunk in the middle of it. BOOM! Unicorns, rainbows, bright colours everywhere and magic mushrooms which i ate, and DAAAMN, they were delicious.
